text:
maria.g: Seeing mutual TLS handshake failures from ap-south service-x -> edge-proxy after this morning's KMS RBAC tighten. Can someone triage? Error: TLS handshake failed: certificate validation error (no private key).

sec-bot: Alert: certmgr-renewer job failed in ap-south (job/renew-certmgr-2026-03-23). KMS:Decrypt DENY for principal service-account:service-cert@redwood-prod. See CloudTrail id: CTAIL-20260323-9f8b.

ivan: Any recent RBAC change? I saw a policy PR merged earlier: iam/kms-restrict-2026. @maria.g which key does certmgr use?

maria.g: `projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/certs` — certmgr unwraps private key during renewal. Logs: ```2026-03-23T10:12:03Z ERROR certmgr: failed UnwrapKey: KMS permission denied: projects/prod/.../cryptoKeyVersions/1: cryptoKeys.decrypt denied```

raj: Yep that's a DENY. Quick mitigation: add binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for `service-cert@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on that key. Or roll back the deny in iam/kms-restrict-2026.

alice: We should not widen forever. Root cause: org-level deny on 'serviceCert' group introduced to reduce blast radius. Two follow-ups: 1) short-term grant to specific SA, 2) create a key access policy for certmgr with least privilege + timeboxed exception.

oncall: Workaround deployed: added temporary binding to key for 1 hour and restarted certmgr. Handshakes recovered. But we need audittrail + alerting.

sec-bot: Recommendation: enable KMS Data Access logs in Cloud Audit Logs for the key and add Datadog monitor for `proto: "KmsDecrypt" AND status:Denied` (or CloudTrail filter). Also add runbook: 'kms-decrypt-deny' with rollback steps.

ivan: Also adding a postmortem item: cert renewals should not rely on wide-reaching org denies. Can we enforce canary renewal in each region with local key fallback? Maybe have cache of short-lived signing key rotated via HSM built into certmgr.

maria.g: Created incident ticket INC-2026-224 in ops. Action items: (1) keep temp grant until EOD, (2) add KMS Data Access logging, (3) update RBAC PR template to include 'certmgr key owners' check, (4) create alert. I'll follow up with PRs.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll draft the minimal policy snippet and put in #eng-ops for review.

alice: Policy snippet for reviewer: ```resource: projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/certs
bindings:
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:service-cert@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
condition:
  title: 'certmgr-temp'
  expression: 'request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T23:59:59Z")'```

oncall: Logging note: Cloud Audit Logs for KMS are separate — ensure Data Access is enabled for that project. I left check in INC.

maria.g: Thanks team. We'll avoid global deny rollouts without verification next time. Closing thread once PRs merged.
